telemetry.none: DSAExperimentation is a self-contained algorithms/data-structures practice library: its production projects do no I/O, run no services and have no consumers outside the repository's own test and benchmark projects - there is nothing there for a logger, tracer, or metric to observe. The one network client in the repository, the LeetCode catalog's GraphQL fetcher in DSAExperimentation.LeetCode.Tests/LeetCodeCatalog, is test tooling that refreshes cached problem fixtures when run by hand; it is not a service, and its only observer is the developer who ran it.
